firm_data.firm_description: Allyn & Fortuna LLP provides legal representation for business clients in New York and New Jersey, focusing on commercial litigation, administrative and regulatory law, and employment law for employers.
notable_facts: The firm was established in New York City in 1990 and expanded to New Jersey in 1995.

email.subject: AI for Allyn & Fortuna LLP, built for firms like yours
email.body:
Hi Nicholas,

Allyn & Fortuna has built real expertise across commercial litigation, administrative law, and employment law since 1990, serving Fortune 500 clients across New York and New Jersey. That combination of complexity and scale is exactly what we see in the firms that benefit most from AI.

I lead business at Lucio, an AI platform built for law firms that face BigLaw demands with leaner teams. We recently raised $5M, and firms across 9 jurisdictions have chosen us over Harvey because we focus on the realities of practices like yours: precision, client trust, and efficiency.

Having completed successful pilots on the East Coast, we're now meeting regional firms to show how ex-lawyers ourselves are helping similar practices compete. Worth 20 minutes to explore?

Vasu
Lucio
